responsibility: Implements the early VRP pass itself, including the folder variants that consume EVRP and ranger information to simplify GIMPLE in dominator order. Besides driving the pass pipeline setup, it defines pointer-equivalence tracking and the hybrid folding machinery that combines traditional EVRP value queries with gimple_ranger results, folds statements and conditions, exports global ranges, and chooses between EVRP-only, ranger-only, or hybrid execution modes based on the EVRP mode parameter.
